notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 5 or greater.
description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
